MP Police GD Constable Online Form 2026 (7500 Posts) – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Constable (General Duty). This recruitment has been issued for 7500 posts. The online application process for MPESB MP Police GD Constable Recruitment 2026 will start from 22 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 06 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB MP Police GD Constable Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2026
  • Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 11 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 19 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 250/-
  • Portal Charges Extra

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
